example.prompt: A serene mountain landscape at sunset

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video

callback_url.description: URL to receive a webhook notification when the video generation job completes. Overrides the workspace-level default callback URL if set. Must be HTTPS.

creativity.description: Creativity level for video upscaling models only. This parameter is not supported by video generation models.

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds

frame_images.description: Images to use as the first and/or last frame of the generated video. Each image must specify a frame_type of first_frame or last_frame.

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio alongside the video. Defaults to the endpoint's generate_audio capability flag, false if not set.

input_references.description: Reference assets to guide video generation. Accepts image, audio, and video references. Audio and video references are only honored by providers that support them (including BytePlus Seedance generation 2 and newer); other providers use image references and ignore the rest.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate. Optional for models that support generating a video from image input alone; required by all other models.
prompt.example: A serene mountain landscape at sunset

seed.description: If specified, the generation will sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result. Determinism is not guaranteed for all providers.

size.description: Exact pixel dimensions of the generated video in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g. "1280x720"). Interchangeable with resolution + aspect_ratio.

upscale_factor.description: Upscale factor for video upscaling models only. This parameter is not supported by video generation models.

interpretation: No additional prompt maxLength declared. Alibaba HappyHorse model limit is used only for its explicit model identifier; transport acceptance requires live validation.
